text_sanskrit: गाण्डीवं स्रंसते हस्तात्त्वक्चैव परिदह्यते ंअ च शक्नोम्यवस्थातुं भ्रमतीव च मे मनः ॥ १-३० ॥
itrans: gANDIva.n sra.nsate hastAttvakchaiva paridahyate .na cha shaknomyavasthAtuM bhramatIva cha me manaH .. 1-30 ..
translation: Gandiva slips from my hand and my skin burns all over. And I am not able to stand, and my mind is whirling, and I see evil omens, 0 Kesava,
